# Isaiah Chapter 1 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1:1** The-vision [chazon] of-Isaiah [Yesha'yahu] son-of [ben] Amoz [Amotz], which he-saw [asher chazah] concerning Judah [Yehudah] and-Jerusalem [vi-Yerushalayim] in-the-days [bi-yemei] of-Uzziah [Uzziyahu], Jotham [Yotam], Ahaz [Achaz], [and] Hezekiah [Yechizkiyahu], kings [malkhei] of-Judah [Yehudah].

**1:2** Hear [shim'u], O-heavens [shamayim], and-give-ear [ve-ha'azini], O-earth [eretz], for the-LORD [ki YHVH] has-spoken [dibber]: "Children [banim] I-have-reared [giddalti] and-brought-up [ve-romamti], but-they [ve-hem] have-rebelled [pashe'u] against-me [bi]."

**1:3** The-ox [yada shor] knows [yada] its-owner [qonehu], and-the-donkey [va-chamor] [knows] its-master's [be'alav] manger [evus]; Israel [Yisra'el] does-not-know [lo yada], my-people [ammi] does-not-consider [lo hitbonen].

**1:4** Woe [hoi], sinful [choté] nation [goi], a-people [am] laden [keved] with-iniquity [avon], offspring [zera] of-evildoers [mere'im], children [banim] who-deal-corruptly [mashchitim]! They-have-forsaken [azvu] the-LORD [et YHVH], they-have-despised [ni'atzu] the-Holy-One [et Qedosh] of-Israel [Yisra'el], they-have-turned-away [nazoru] backward [achor].

**1:5** Upon what [al meh] will-you-be-struck [tukku] still [od], [that you] continue [tosifu] rebellion [sarah]? Every [kol] head [rosh] [is] sick [la-choli], and-every [ve-khol] heart [levav] [is] faint [davvai].

**1:6** From-the-sole [mi-kaf] of-the-foot [regel] to [ve-ad] the-head [rosh], there-is-no [ein] soundness [metom] in-it [bo] — bruises [petza] and-welts [ve-chabbura] and-raw [u-makkah] wounds [teriyyah]; they-have-not-been-pressed-out [lo zoru] and-not-been-bound [ve-lo chubbash] and-not-been-softened [ve-lo rukkekha] with-oil [ba-shamen].

**1:7** Your-land [artzekhem] [is] a-desolation [shemamah]; your-cities [arekhem] [are] burned [serufot] with-fire [esh]; your-soil [admatekhem] — before-you [le-negdekhem] foreigners [zarim] are-devouring [okhelim] it [otah], and-a-desolation [u-shemamah] like-the-overthrow [ke-mahpekhat] of-strangers [zarim].

**1:8** And-the-daughter [bat] of-Zion [Tziyyon] is-left [ve-noterah] like-a-booth [ke-sukkah] in-a-vineyard [be-kharem], like-a-lodge [ki-melunah] in-a-cucumber-field [be-miqshah], like-a-besieged [ke-ir] city [netzu'ah].

**1:9** If the-LORD [YHVH] of-hosts [Tzeva'ot] had-not-left [hotir] to-us [lanu] a-remnant [sarid] like-a-few [ki-me'at] — like-Sodom [ki-Sedom] we-would-have-been [hayinu], to-Gomorrah [la-Amorah] we-would-have-been-like [daminu].

**1:10** Hear [shim'u] the-word [devar] of-the-LORD [YHVH], rulers [qetzinei] of-Sodom [Sedom]! Give-ear [ha'azinu] to-the-instruction [torat] of-our-God [Eloheinu], people [am] of-Gomorrah [Amorah]!

**1:11** "What [lammah] to-me [li] [is] the-multitude [rov] of-your-sacrifices [zivheikhem]?" says [yomar] the-LORD [YHVH]. "I-am-full [sava'ti] of-burnt-offerings [olot] of-rams [eilim] and-the-fat [ve-chelev] of-fattened-beasts [meri'im]; and-in-the-blood [ve-dam] of-bulls [parim] and-lambs [u-khevasim] and-goats [ve-attudim] I-do-not-delight [lo chafatzti]."

**1:12** "When you-come [ki tavo'u] to-appear [lera'ot] before-me [panai], who [mi] has-required [biqqesh] this [zot] from-your-hand [mi-yedkhem] — to-trample [remos] my-courts [chatzerai]?"

**1:13** "Bring-no-more [lo tosifu havi] vain [shav] offerings [minchat]; incense [qetoret] [is] an-abomination [to'evah] to-me [hi li]. New-moon [chodesh] and-Sabbath [ve-Shabbat], the-calling [qero] of-assembly [miqra] — I-cannot-endure [lo ukhal] iniquity [aven] with-solemn-assembly [va-atzarah]."

**1:14** "Your-new-moons [chodsheikhem] and-your-appointed-feasts [u-mo'adeikhem] my-soul [nafshi] hates [sane'ah]; they-have-become [hayu] a-burden [la-torach] upon-me [alai]; I-am-weary [nil'eiti] of-bearing [neso] [them]."

**1:15** "When you-spread-out [u-ve-farisekhem] your-hands [kapeikhem], I-will-hide [a'alim] my-eyes [einai] from-you [mikkem]; even [gam] when you-multiply [ki tarbu] prayer [tefillah], I-am-not [eineni] listening [shome'a]; your-hands [yedeikhem] are-full [male'u] of-blood [damim]."

**1:16** "Wash [rachatzu], make-yourselves-clean [hizzakku]; remove [hasiru] the-evil [ro'a] of-your-deeds [ma'alelekhem] from-before [mi-neged] my-eyes [einai]; cease [chidlu] doing-evil [hare'a]."

**1:17** "Learn [limdu] to-do-good [hetev]; seek [dirshu] justice [mishpat]; correct [ashru] the-oppressor [chamotz]; defend [shiftu] the-fatherless [yatom]; plead [rivu] for-the-widow [almanah]."

**1:18** "Come [lekhu] now [na] and-let-us-reason-together [ve-nivvakhechah], says [yomar] the-LORD [YHVH]: though [im] your-sins [chata'eikhem] are-like [yihyu ka-] scarlet [shanim], like-snow [ka-sheleg] they-shall-be-white [yalbinu]; though [im] they-are-red [ya'dimu] like-crimson [ka-tola], like-wool [ka-tzemer] they-shall-be [yihyu]."

**1:19** "If you-are-willing [im tovu] and-obedient [u-shma'tem], the-good [tuv] of-the-land [ha-aretz] you-shall-eat [tokheilu]."

**1:20** "But-if [ve-im] you-refuse [tema'enu] and-rebel [u-meritem], by-the-sword [cherev] you-shall-be-devoured [te'ukkhelu]; for the-mouth [ki pi] of-the-LORD [YHVH] has-spoken [dibber]."

**1:21** How [eikhah] the-faithful [ne'emanah] city [qiryah] has-become [hayetah] a-harlot [le-zonah]! She-was-full [mele'ati] of-justice [mishpat]; righteousness [tzedeq] lodged [yalin] in-her [bah], but-now [ve-attah] murderers [meratzechim].

**1:22** Your-silver [kaspekh] has-become [hayah] dross [le-sigim]; your-wine [sov'ekh] diluted [mahul] with-water [ba-mayim].

**1:23** Your-rulers [sarayikh] [are] rebels [sorerim] and-companions [ve-chaverei] of-thieves [gannavim]; every-one [kullo] loves [ohev] bribes [shochad] and-pursues [ve-rodef] gifts [shalmonim]. The-fatherless [yatom] they-do-not-defend [lo yishpotu], and-the-cause [ve-riv] of-the-widow [almanah] does-not-come [lo yavo] to-them [alehem].

**1:24** Therefore [lakhen] — declares [ne'um] the-Lord [ha-Adon] the-LORD [YHVH] of-hosts [Tzeva'ot], the-Mighty-One [Avir] of-Israel [Yisra'el]: "Ah [hoi], I-will-get-relief [ennachem] from-my-adversaries [mi-tzarai] and-avenge-myself [ve-innaqmah] on-my-enemies [me-oyvai]."

**1:25** "And-I-will-turn [va-ashivah] my-hand [yadi] against-you [alayikh] and-I-will-smelt [ve-etzrof] your-dross [sigayikh] as-with-lye [ka-bor] and-I-will-remove [va-asirah] all your-alloy [kol bedilayikh]."

**1:26** "And-I-will-restore [va-ashivah] your-judges [shofetayikh] as-at-first [ke-varishonah] and-your-counselors [ve-yo'atzayikh] as-at-the-beginning [ke-vattechillah]. Afterward [acharei khen] you-shall-be-called [yiqqare lakh] City [ir] of-Righteousness [ha-Tzedeq], Faithful [Ne'emanah] Town [Qiryah]."

**1:27** Zion [Tziyyon] shall-be-redeemed [be-mishpat tippade] by-justice, and-her-repentant-ones [ve-shaveha] by-righteousness [bi-tzdaqah].

**1:28** But-the-destruction [ve-shever] of-transgressors [posh'im] and-sinners [ve-chatta'im] [shall be] together [yachdav], and-those-who-forsake [ve-ozvei] the-LORD [YHVH] shall-be-consumed [yikhlu].

**1:29** For they-shall-be-ashamed [ki yevoshu] of-the-oaks [me-eilim] that [asher] you-desired [chamadtem], and-you-shall-blush [ve-tachperu] for-the-gardens [me-ha-gannot] that [asher] you-chose [becharten].

**1:30** For you-shall-be [ki tihyu] like-an-oak [ke-elah] whose-leaf [aleha] withers [noveleth], and-like-a-garden [u-khe-gannah] that [asher] has-no [ein] water [mayim] in-it [lah].

**1:31** And-the-strong [ve-hayah he-chason] shall-become [li-ne'oret] tow, and-his-work [u-fo'alo] a-spark [le-nitzots]; and-both [u-va'aru shneihem] shall-burn [yachdav] together [ve-ein] and-none [mekhabbeh] shall-quench [them].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Vision" (chazon):** The word *chazon* ("vision") frames the entire book as prophetic revelation. Isaiah's name (*Yesha'yahu*) means "YHVH is salvation" — the book's central theological claim.

**v.9 — Sodom and Gomorrah:** The comparison is shocking: Judah's leaders are "rulers of Sodom," its people "people of Gomorrah." Without a remnant (*sarid*), they would share the same fate.

**v.18 — "scarlet/snow... crimson/wool":** The double comparison creates an a/b//a'/b' pattern. *Shanim* (scarlet) and *tola* (crimson/scarlet worm) are both terms for deep-dyed red fabric — the most permanent of ancient dyes. The promise is that even the most indelible stain can be made white.

*-- EMET*
